description.value: The Narrows Smokehouse is a dedicated slow-smoked BBQ restaurant in Sicamous, specializing in brisket, pulled pork, and ribs cooked low and slow alongside housemade sauces and classic sides. The full-service menu extends to cocktails, craft mocktails, beer on tap, and wine, making it a proper sit-down stop on a touring route through the Shuswap corridor. Catering and takeout are available, and the kitchen offers dedicated gluten-free, vegetarian, and food allergy menus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active BBQ restaurant at 221 Main Street, Sicamous, BC with phone +1-(236)-836-0608. The site explicitly advertises 'Take-out HOT-TO-GO' and a dietary restrictions menu listing Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, and Lactose-Free options. OSM opening hours (Mo-Su) conflict with the website's stated Wednesday-Sunday schedule — flagged in concerns but hours are excluded per rules.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag states Mo-Su 15:00-21:30 (7 days), but website clearly states 'Wednesday-Sunday Only' — OSM hours appear inaccurate and may mislead cyclists planning a visit.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible BBQ restaurant confirmed by website content with address, phone, and menu detail. A solid food stop for touring cyclists passing through Sicamous.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists a dedicated 'Dietary Restrictions Menu' covering Gluten-Free, Vegetarian, Lactose-Free, and Food Allergy options
